summary.text: Riaz Khan is the Republican candidate for Washington State Senate District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Marko Liias.

paragraphs.text: Khan was a 2016 candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 21-Position 2, listing no party preference.
In 2018 he was listed as a Democratic candidate in the primary for the District 21 Senate seat, receiving 13.1 percent of the vote and not advancing.
In 2024 he advanced from the primary for House District 21-Position 1 alongside incumbent Strom Peterson, with 27.4 percent of the vote.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Senate primary with 28.3 percent of the vote to Liias's 71.7 percent.
